forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.help: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It can take a few minutes, so check your spam folder too. Open the link in this same browser.
forgot.googleHint: Signed up with Google? Go back and use Continue with Google instead.
forgot.failed: We could not send the email. Try again in a moment.

reset.invalidHelp: Reset links expire and only work once, in the browser that asked for them. Go back to sign in and choose Forgot password? to get a new one.
reset.doneHelp: You are signed in with your new password.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.help: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.failed: We could not update your password. Try again.
